statement: Publishing checks the publisher again on the current heads: their authorization of every target and the grant analysis. What they cannot publish alone waits for approval, and nothing is written.
guards: control:ControlAuthorizationTest#publishing checks the publisher again on the current heads
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#a publisher without the rights the change needs cannot publish another's change
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#an author who lost cosec grant after proposing cannot publish
control:ControlAuthorizationTest#an author who lost cosec publish after staging cannot publish
